method: Selected + translated from this project's own RU/IT/DE anecdote corpora (data/anecdotes, data/anecdotes-it, data/anecdotes-de). Each candidate joke was passed through an LLM filter with three drop rules in order: (1) unsafe — inappropriate for general YouTube audience, (2) wordplay — humor mechanism depends on untranslatable source-language wordplay/rhyme/homophony, (3) cultural — joke requires source-country-specific knowledge to land (being merely SET in an everyday RU/IT/DE context is not itself a reason to drop). Everything that survived was translated into natural conversational Romanian with a new title. Nothing was invented by the LLM — every final card traces back to a real line in the source titled.json files.
builtWith: Claude Sonnet 5, Workflow tool, 131 batches of ~30 candidates each
